content.unEditedContent:
DevOps Engineer (6-Month Contract) - $1000 per day - Brisbane - Immediate start.


About the Role:

Tech and Data People are working with a company who are considered to be an employer of choice in Brisbane. We are looking for an experienced DevOps Engineer for a 6-month contract, focusing on automation, CI/CD pipeline optimisation, and infrastructure delivery. You’ll be instrumental in building, deploying, and maintaining scalable and robust systems in a cloud environment. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced setting and has hands-on experience with Kubernetes, CI/CD practices, and scripting in Bash and Python.
 
Responsibilities:
  • Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines to improve development and deployment speed.
  • Manage Kubernetes clusters and automate deployment processes.
  • Write and maintain scripts in Bash and Python to support automation tasks.
  • Collaborate with development teams to understand requirements and ensure effective infrastructure support.
  • Continuously enhance deployment strategies, monitoring, and logging.
  • Use Git for version control and ensure that all deployments are tracked and managed correctly.
  • Deliver solutions within agreed timelines, balancing quality and efficiency.
Key Skills and Qualifications:
  • 3+ years of experience in a DevOps role or similar.
  • Proficiency in Kubernetes for container orchestration.
  • Strong understanding of CI/CD tools and best practices.
  • Skilled in Git for source control management.
  • Scripting experience with Bash and Python for automation.
  • Experience with cloud services (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud preferred).
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team to deliver high-quality work on time.
Bonus Skills:
  • Experience with IaC (Terraform, Ansible).
  • Knowledge of monitoring tools (Prometheus, Grafana, etc.).
 
If you're a DevOps Engineer ready to hit the ground running and make an immediate impact, apply today!
